preview: Today’s episode looks at how personalized news feeds shape what appears on our screens. They may help us find relevant stories, but they also raise a question about what we might not see. By the end, you will understand what these feeds change about the way people follow the news.
comment_1: As you listen, notice both the helpful side and the possible concern.
comment_2: Now, you will hear two people speak in their own words, one after the other. Each one brings a different view to the same question.
comment_3: These voices do not give us a simple choice between right and wrong. They show that the same news feed can feel useful to one person and limiting to another, so next we will look at why the same situation can feel different to different people.
comment_4: Instead of asking only who is right, let’s ask what is shaping this situation in the first place. That question takes us past the surface disagreement.
